ledger: Exterior (00:00): Rectangular diner building with front glass doors, large wrap-around front windows, parking lot, white semi-truck parked on left exterior.
Interior Main Dining & Counter Area (00:10): Long counter with swivel stools running parallel to rear wall; kitchen pass-through window set in back wall behind counter.
Entrance Traversal (00:19): Customer enters dining room from exterior front door on left wall next to booth seating; exterior view through windows shows twilight sky.
Kitchen Interior View (00:45): View through pass-through opening looking from kitchen into dining area; shows counter, customer, exit door, and front exterior windows.
Dining Area (01:00): Morning sunlight through front windows; counter stools, booths, and kitchen pass-through spatially aligned with prior shots.
Counter View (01:27): Waitress and customer at counter; front exterior windows behind them show sunrise in background.
Exit Traversal (01:41): Customer leaves dining area through front door into parking lot towards green semi-truck parked outside window.
Exterior View from Interior (01:46): Waitress at front window booth looks out into parking lot; vehicle and driver exterior positions match window line-of-sight.
